entity_types.name: Product
entity_types.description: A finished furniture item offered in the catalog and reviewed as a unit (e.g. the Helsingborg Dresser or the Malmö Desk); not its individual parts, its materials, or the process of putting it together.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: An individual named physical part of a product that can be sourced and can fail on its own (e.g. drawer rail, slat, screw, panel, leg, cushion, drawer handle); not a raw material and not the product as a whole.

entity_types.name: Material
entity_types.description: A substance or stock that a product or component is made from or finished with (e.g. solid wood, veneer, MDF, cardboard, metal, polyester blend, multi-layer finish); not a discrete part that could be replaced on its own.

entity_types.name: Supplier
entity_types.description: An external vendor that provides a part or material used in a product, including one referred to only as 'a supplier'; not the retailer, the reviewer, or the maker of the finished product.

entity_types.name: AssemblyProcess
entity_types.description: The act and experience of putting a product together from its components, including how long it takes and how hard it is; not the finished product, and not an assembly specification or instruction document.

entity_types.name: Condition
entity_types.description: A concrete physical or functional condition reported about a product, component, material or assembly — either a defect/failure symptom (misaligned pre-drilled holes, rough drawer-rail edges, wobble, cracking) or a notable strength (smooth drawer action, scratch resistance); not a star rating, price, or general opinion.

fact_types.description: A component is a part of the product; e.g. 'the drawer rails of the dresser'. Derived because a review document is about one product, so any named part belongs to it.
The product as a whole is constructed from or finished with a material; e.g. 'solid wood construction', 'upholstered in a commercial-grade polyester blend'.
A specific component is made of a material; e.g. 'the back panel is basically cardboard', 'the slats are wood'.
A component or batch of components comes from an external vendor; e.g. 'a recent batch of drawer hardware from their supplier'.
The assembly process is the putting-together of a particular product; e.g. 'assembly of the Helsingborg Dresser took over 5 hours'.
How long the assembly process takes; e.g. 'assembly took about an hour', 'less than 20 minutes'; the Value carries the amount and unit.
A reported condition of the assembly process itself, such as being straightforward, a nightmare, confusing, or requiring two people.
A physical or functional condition observed on the whole product; e.g. 'the table wobbles', 'the frame creaks when someone sits down', 'the finish resists scratches'.
A physical or functional condition observed on a component; e.g. 'the drawer rails have rough, uneven edges', 'the drawer slides smoothly', 'the slats cracked'.
A condition observed about the material a product or component is made of; e.g. 'the veneer is extremely thin and already chipping'.
A quantified property of the product — dimension, weight, capacity or price; e.g. '180cm x 90cm', 'seats 6-8 people', '22cm diameter base'.
A quantified property of a component; e.g. 'slats are 8mm thick with 7cm spacing', 'drawer slides rated for 25kg'.
The star rating the review gives the product; e.g. '5/5' or '2/5'.
A component is the cause of a reported condition elsewhere in the product or its assembly; e.g. 'defective drawer rails make the drawers stick and the assembly hard'.
A supplier, or a part/material it provided, is the reported cause of a condition; e.g. 'issues with drawer hardware from their supplier'.
One reported condition leads to another; e.g. misaligned pre-drilled holes make assembly difficult, or rough rails make drawers stick.

One component lines up, fits or fails to fit with another component during assembly; e.g. 'pre-drilled holes didn't line up', 'some parts didn't fit together properly'; the tone records whether the fit was good or bad.
